newsitem.title: USA: Grand Union sees Q1 below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Grand Union sees Q1 below expectations.

text.p: Grand Union Co said Thursday that preliminary first quarter results are below company expectations and result in a technical financial covenant default under its bank lending agreement.
The company did provide a first quarter number and did not answer a call to its offices in New Jersey Thursday evening.
The company said, however, that it has not missed any payments to its bankers or bondholders and that it is current with all vendor payments.

It said comparable store sales for the four weeks ended July 19 rose from the same period last year, adding that recent preliminary results indicate sales have continued to improve during the current period.
Grand Union, which operates 224 retail food stores, also said it is nearing the end of its search for a new chief executive and expects to announce the appointment shortly.
